name: lotus pond
description: Shallow green water crowded with round lotus leaves standing on their stalks, pink flowers and seed heads above them.  Đầm Sen means lotus pond.

name: Ferris wheel
description: The big wheel: a white steel ring hung with coloured gondolas, turning slowly over the park every evening while the music played.  The motor is dead and a gondola near the top creaks in the wind.  The hub is a long climb up.

name: giant legendary statue
description: A painted concrete giant towering over the artificial beach: Lạc Long Quân, the dragon lord of the sea, father of the hundred eggs from which the Vietnamese were born.  A waterfall used to pour from the rocks at his feet.

name: kỳ lân statue
description: A gaudy concrete kỳ lân, the scaled, horned guardian beast of the old legends, painted gold, green and red and baring its teeth at the park gate.

name: giant painted dragon
description: A concrete dragon ten metres long, its coils rising and dipping through the garden, painted bright blue and orange.  Children used to climb its back for photographs.

name: swan pedal boat
description: A fibreglass pedal boat shaped like a white swan, moored at the jetty.  Couples pedalled them round the lake on Sunday afternoons.  This one has a crack in the hull and a puddle in the seat well.

//: The park train that ran round Đầm Sen and Suối Tiên: dda's miniature train locomotive.
